message: To initiate Rework, open a completed, unarchived Production Job and select 'Create Rework.' Choose a Reason, describe the Rework Scope, and enter the Intake/Return Date. Only one Rework cycle can be active at a time. Rework preserves the original Job's status and dates.

sources.title: Initiate Job Rework
sources.guidance: Authorized business writers can create Rework for a completed Production Job. Open the Job in Production and select Create Rework. Choose a Reason, describe Rework Scope / Work Required, enter Intake / Return Date, then select Create Rework. The Job must be complete, unarchived and have no active Rework cycle. Only one Rework cycle can be active at a time. Rework remains on the same canonical Job and preserves original Production status and dates. Scope is a whole-Job description, not structured piece or Color Plate tracking.

sources.title: Production Rework lifecycle and requirements
sources.guidance: Rework belongs to an existing canonical Production Job. Only one active Rework is allowed; eligible Job states and the actual Create Rework action remain authoritative. TenOps models Rework as a lifecycle belonging to one canonical commercial Production Job. The Job number, customer, commercial values, documents, attachments, Purchase Orders, Transmittals, and Job Updates remain job-scoped. The original lifecycle remains on jobs; Rework never overwrites its status or planned dates. Only one Rework can be active for a Job, while completed and cancelled cycles remain historical.
